question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.**

Termagant

options.text: A violent, overbearing, turbulent, brawling, quarrelsome woman

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Termagant"** means a violent, overbearing, turbulent, brawling, quarrelsome woman. (उग्र, झगड़ालू औरत)
 
 
• **Example:** The character in the play was portrayed as a termagant, always causing trouble and picking fights.
 
 
 
• **"Termagant"** refers to a woman who is violent, overbearing, and quarrelsome. (उग्र, झगड़ालू औरत)
 
 
• **Example:** She acted like a termagant, yelling at everyone in the office for the smallest mistakes.
